mission: Veraine's ritual building at the Scar — amplified by the repurposed node network. The wound responding, the Scar widening. The three forces converging: Veraine at the epicenter, Torin descending, the resonance trio at mid-valley.
why_now: The climax infrastructure is in motion — all three forces active simultaneously
conflict: The physical environment deteriorating as all three operations stress the lattice. The wrongness becoming acute — not just uncomfortable but dangerous. The wound amplifying emotions, making concentration nearly impossible.
turning_point: Ben feels all three operations in the Force simultaneously: Veraine's ritual (calculated, amplified, aimed at the Scar), Torin's technique (personal, immediate, the lattice dissolving around him), and the beginning of their own resonance (discordant, uncertain). Three operations pulling the Force in three different directions.
opening_hook: The Scar widens. Not dramatically — a centimeter, maybe two. Enough to be visible. Enough to be terrifying.
closing_hook: Ben: 'Now.' He reaches for Sera and Kael through the Force. Three traditions. Three wounds. One chance.
emotional_trajectory: Environmental overwhelm -> focus through chaos -> the call to begin

stakes.personal: Ben committing to the resonance — no more preparation, no more theory
stakes.interpersonal: Three people trusting each other with their lives and their Force connections
stakes.external: Three operations competing at the wound site — only one can succeed

setting: Veranthos — mid-valley position, Scar visible, Torin visible, Veraine's ritual visible
sensory_details: The Scar widening; Veraine's ritual — a distortion at the Scar's base, calculated and focused; Torin's technique — the lattice dissolving around him as he descends, a moving void; the resonance starting point — three Force presences reaching for each other, discordant
notes: The three operations coexisting creates the climax's physical texture. Each is a different type of Force manipulation, and Ben can feel all three. The sensory vocabulary should be at maximum density here.
